patronOf.en-US: The beloved Son revealed at the Jordan
patronOf.pt-BR: O Filho amado revelado no Jordão

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Behold the One of whom John said: I have seen and testified that this is the Son of God.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Eis aquele de quem João dizia: Eu vi, e dou testemunho: este é o Filho de Deus!

meta.face: Christ as in recurring-figures.md: a man of about thirty-three with a LONG OVAL face narrowing gently to the chin — a high, smooth forehead, a long straight nose with a fine bridge, calm almond-shaped dark-brown eyes under level brown brows, high, softly modelled cheekbones, a quiet closed mouth; chestnut-brown hair parted in the centre and falling in soft waves past the shoulders; a short, full chestnut beard and moustache, lightly parted at the chin; eyes lowered in humility. John as on the john_baptist card: a man of about thirty with a LONG face — high cheekbones, a straight nose, large dark-brown eyes under straight dark brows, a firm mouth; thick, unkempt curly dark-brown hair to the shoulders and a rough, short dark-brown beard, sunburnt wilderness skin; a reverent look. The two must stay clearly different: Christ's hair smooth, chestnut and centre-parted, John's dark, wild and curly. The angels: fair, childlike, one round-faced with golden curls, one with an oval face and light-brown hair.
meta.basis: Matthew 3:13-17 and the feast's entrance antiphon; the composition follows Verrocchio and Leonardo's Baptism of Christ (Uffizi), with John pouring from a shell and angels holding the garments. John keeps the `john_baptist` card's face and Christ the new line in recurring-figures.md.
